text: The authors note that Irving et al.'s debate proposal captures PSPACE but models both provers as computationally unbounded, leaving open whether real models can implement the protocols efficiently and whether a bounded dishonest prover gains an advantage. Their doubly-efficient debate model gives protocols in which the honest prover always has a winning strategy implementable in polynomial time, even against a computationally unbounded dishonest prover.
title: Brown-Cohen et al.'s doubly-efficient debate gives Irving et al.'s debate a poly-time honest prover
